articles.summary: The disability minister has been looking into disability benefits for a year for his review, which is to be published on Tuesday A review into the personal independence payment (Pip) will call for a "fundamental overhaul" of the assessment process to "better recognise people's varying costs and needs", the disability…
key_points: Sir Stephen Timms has been looking into disability benefits for the past year and found the set up was "no longer fit for purpose".
Writing in the Times , external , he said his review, to be published in full on Tuesday, would recommend people with the most severe conditions have a "fast track" process which is…
It comes after a separate review into young people not in education, employment or training (Neets) recommended Pip be scrapped and replaced for under-25s.

articles.title: Energy bills will soar - here's how you can ease the pain
articles.description: Household energy bills are about to increase but there are ways to keep a lid on your expenditure.
articles.summary: Keeping yourself warm by wearing thick clothes, using blankets and having hot drinks can help reduce heating bills Energy prices are forecast to rise by 26% for millions of homes in January, but experts say there are ways to keep a check on rising bills.
key_points: Energy regulator Ofgem's price cap, as well as suppliers' fixed deals, set a limit on the price of each unit of energy, not the total bill.
Millions of people have cut back on their energy consumption during years of relatively high prices.
Ofgem says about five million people still pay their bill when it arrives every three months, rather than receive a monthly bill often initially based on an estimate.

articles.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
articles.description: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".
articles.summary: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89.
key_points: His family announced the news, remembering him as "the greatest jeweller of our time", according to Italian media.
Paolo Bulgari was Chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984 and its jewellery pieces have adorned Hollywood stars and royalty including Diana, Princess of Wales.
The company Bvlgari posted an online tribute to the "true creative soul", whose work would "continue to inspire generations to come".

articles.title: What is going on with Poundland?
articles.description: Poundland has a matter of days to find a buyer or face collapsing into administration. Why?
articles.summary: The future of Poundland hangs in the balance as it faces a possible collapse into administration.
key_points: Its owner, US investment firm Gordon Brothers, put it up for sale in September, but then rejected offers to keep the business afloat.
Poundland has a major presence on the High Street, with 600 stores in the UK and Ireland, where it trades under the Dealz brand.
If it were to collapse, the jobs of its 11,000 employees would be at risk, as well as potentially thousands of others at firms that supply the retailer.

articles.title: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing
articles.description: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.
articles.summary: The owner of a small San Francisco dog-walking company, she has been hiring staff and buying vans.
key_points: Fuelling the growth is her new office dog-walking service Paw Perk, popular with some local AI start-ups.
Her business is an example of how the AI boom in San Francisco is benefiting other sectors.
The city saw an exodus of residents during the pandemic and its downtown was weakened by remote work, but it s now enjoying a rejuvenation, with AI being the major driver.
